claims.claim: After episode 1 almost all entries are in stretto, always at one bar's distance.
Six stretti include eight separate pairs of overlapping entries (list of intervals).
Only modulation is to v (cadence 20-21); bars 34-37 suggest iv; no major-key entries.
No new thematic material after bar 4; one of the most unified fugues of the 48.
Of ten direct entries after the exposition only bar 28 is exactly like the opening.
Stretto 1: soprano at 13 imitates (by contrary motion) middle voice of bar 12 without overlap; stretto proper begins at 14.

Review p.80: All four combinations of direct and inverted subject are equally effective; stretto entries always after one beat's interval, pitch interval greatly varied. NB p.70 says "always at one bar's distance" (internal inconsistency; checked on both page images).
